verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor (APU), so subscribing to events via registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it or its Ryzen AI software stack shipping webhooks: the documented interfaces are ONNX Runtime APIs, the Lemonade SDK, an LLM server interface, and the xrt-smi CLI, with no outbound callbacks. The failed OpenAPI probe also turned up no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
